title: Melanoma (cutaneous)
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for cutaneous melanoma. Captures setting/intent and BRAF V600 status, then routes to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference (BRAF/MEK-targeted therapy requires a BRAF V600 mutation; immunotherapy applies regardless of BRAF). Invents no dose/regimen/criterion. Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Cutaneous Melanoma; no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Cutaneous Melanoma. Options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.name: Setting and intent
nodes.title: Setting and intent
nodes.description: Adjuvant therapy for resected stage III disease is curative-intent; unresectable stage III or stage IV disease is treated with palliative intent.

nodes.name: BRAF status
nodes.title: BRAF V600 mutation status
nodes.description: A BRAF V600 activating mutation (V600E/K) enables BRAF/MEK-targeted therapy in addition to immunotherapy. BRAF wild-type disease is treated with immunotherapy.

nodes.name: BRAF-mutant melanoma
nodes.title: BRAF V600-mutant: targeted therapy or immunotherapy
nodes.description: BRAF V600-mutant melanoma - BRAF/MEK-targeted therapy and immunotherapy are both options (immunotherapy is often preferred first-line in advanced disease). Narrowed by setting. Physician selects.

nodes.name: BRAF wild-type melanoma
nodes.title: BRAF wild-type: immunotherapy
nodes.description: BRAF wild-type melanoma - immune checkpoint inhibition is the systemic backbone, narrowed by setting. Physician selects.
